positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions - AI marketing agents (Azure)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Machine learning infrastructure

Part of the team that rebuilt and migrated LinkedIn's internal job ingestion and processing system:
- Developed a more efficient system to conserve resources on newer, more expensive LLM and ranking models.
- Enabled AI teams to seamlessly deploy and A/B test models that process incoming jobs.
- Implemented automatic versioning, storage, pipelines, provisioning, internal connectors, and bootstrapping.
- Designed generically to allow other ingestion teams to utilize the same technology for their entities. E.g. member ingestion, resume ingestion.
- "Transparently" migrated hundreds of internal clients to minimize migration efforts.
- The project was successful across the board, drastically lowering AI overhead and showing positive A/B test results.

positions.title: Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
R&D and Prototyping

•	Upgraded a McDonald’s drive-thru machine to use more concentrated syrups. Built a demo and tested the performance to industry standards. Calculated savings of $20M/year nationwide.
•	Designed and built a Freestyle machine prototype that was later approved for development and implementation nationwide. Demonstrated the the machine to the CTO of the company.
•	Coded a developer interface involving TCP/IP package communication between machines. Expedited the prototype process by 1.5 years in 3 days, drastically anticipating the project’s deadline.
•	Created the testing protocol and built a testing reliability unit containing 40 independently run pumps. Coded the LabVIEW program and finished the wiring.
•	Designed and ordered to manufacture a PCB (Printed Circuit Board) Arduino shield that controls the refrigeration unit of a Dasani dispenser prototype, which was tested at Georgia Tech’s campus.

Equipment and Commercialization

•	Designed and implemented a low-cost electric replacement for a pneumatic cylinder and cup gripper for a dispenser. Reduced CO2 emissions and increased reliability. Calculated savings of $3M/year nationwide.
•	Improved machine’s reliability by replacing metal parts with plastic rust resistant ones.

volunteerExperiences.description: Created a set of battery powered, Raspberry Pi Wi-Fi access points used by volunteer doctors in Papua New Guinea. Used to transmit patient data in between stations where cellular data is not available.
